Removing end fans reveals the upper rim and inner/back wall; the outer cylinder remains unchanged. The chosen view cannot inspect every hidden face.
The cylinder keeps its silhouette and cap outline while the bands shift to teal, dark blue, ochre and rust. Exact retained geometry identity is separately established by source/native hashes.
Three smaller separated objects display the cylinder, waist and pointed profiles through the same renderer and local transforms.
